notes.title: Update ver 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Delayed the boss's first action when playing on Lunatic difficulty.

Adjusted the durability of Bolmotz’s Deka-Marten based on difficulty level.

Fine-tuned vertical forced camera scrolling in some stages.

Fixed an issue where some boss characters were not monochrome after being cleared.

Adjusted the game to make it clear when a second character becomes available after the first clear.

Updated the description of "Jammer Search＋".

Fixed an issue where save data initialization was not working correctly.

Corrected incorrect button icon display for cancel.

Fixed a typo in ruby text in the Record section.

Changed button prompts to keyboard keys when playing with a keyboard.

Fixed an issue where keyboard settings were not applied correctly.

Fixed button duplication indicators becoming misaligned when scrolling in button settings.

Fixed an issue where the effects of Jammer Search＋ persisted after retrying.

Fixed missing event scene images.

Adjusted text balloon slide timing in pre-battle conversations.

Corrected Franzha's description from “Demon God” to the proper term.

Fixed some text still displaying in Japanese in the Chinese localization.

Fixed an issue where enemy PLAYING LEVEL couldn't be obtained.

Fixed an issue where falling during Franzha's Himmel Teten would disable controls for several seconds.

notes.title: Update ver 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where Punishment could not be activated while jumping upward.

Fixed an issue where Warp could be used from the Call Menu even if it hadn't been obtained.

Fixed an issue where dash-jumping on the long staircase in Dannebrog Castle would cause the player to fall through.

Fixed an issue where enemy defeat achievements would not unlock.

Fixed an issue where Battle Arena clear times would overwrite regular play times.

Note: Records believed to be from Battle Arena will be removed from the online rankings within a few days.

Note: As a special measure, a hidden command has been added to reset clear times on the Records screen.
Hold the following keys for 6 seconds to delete each difficulty’s record:

Hike: Press H

Action: Press A

Parkour: Press P

Lunatic: Press L
(The displayed character's time will be deleted. Once deleted, it cannot be restored, so please be careful.)
